lines.t: Verse 1
Every breath feels like a whisper in the dark,
Your name burns inside the hollow of my heart.
I reach but only touch the shadow of Your hand,
Still I’m falling toward the promise where You stand.
Pre-Chorus
And I remember what You said—
“Come and rest, come and be fed.”
Your mercy wraps around my fear,
I can almost feel You here.
Chorus
Hold me, Lord, till I hurt no more,
Pull me through this aching door.
My soul is calling, come—
I’m undone in Your arms.
I see Your light behind the veil,
My tears like rivers start to pale.
You are the fire, the calm in the storm,
I’m undone in Your arms.
Verse 2
You said Your heart was broken too,
For every love that turned from You.
Still You wait and whisper low,
“I’m near—your heart, I know.”
Pre-Chorus
And I believe what I can’t see,
The world fades—You’re all I need.
I’m reaching past the pain and fear,
To find the One who’s always near.
Chorus
Hold me, Lord, till I hurt no more,
Pull me through this aching door.
My soul is calling, come—
I’m undone in Your arms.
I see Your light behind the veil,
My tears like rivers start to pale.
You are the fire, the calm in the storm,
I’m undone in Your arms.
Bridge
When the heavens open wide,
You’ll come for me in glory’s tide.
And every tear and shadow gone—
We’ll finally be one.
Hold me, Lord, now and forevermore,
You’re the peace I’ve waited for.
My heart is calling, come—
I’m undone in Your arms.
Your love eternal, fierce, and warm,
I am home in Your arms.
I am home in Your arms.
